hints: minimum is a while loop going left. No recursion needed, and it is the helper successor calls.
successor case 1: if x has a right subtree, the answer is the minimum of that subtree - the smallest thing bigger than x.

successor case 2: no right subtree means you have finished x's whole subtree, so walk up. While x is its parent's RIGHT child, keep climbing; the first time you arrive from the left, that parent is the successor. Reaching NULL means x was the maximum.
source: NITC_Lab_S3_DSA Week 2 - BSTs, ADT functions min(T) and successor(T,x)
title: Week 2 ADT: minimum, maximum, successor, predecessor
